newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end modestly higher, but lack energy.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end modestly higher, but lack energy.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed modestly higher on Thursday, partly heartened by another bullish run on Wall Street overnight, brokers said.
But volume remained slack, fuelling sentiment that it would take time for the index to break out of its recent range, they said.
Real estate shares attracted investors, buoyed by renewed expectations of a recovery in land prices, also supporting the Tokyo market, they said.
The 225-share Nikkei average rose 155.72 points or 0.77 percent to close at 20,286.23.
After real estate, other advancing sectors were precision instruments, land transport, automobiles and electric equipment.
The major losing sectors were transport equipment, gas and credit/lease.
The second section index was down 5.79 points at 1,785.27, with 6.05 million shares traded.
The over-the-counter (OTC) index was down 5.85 points at 1,147.08.
